Convenience
  • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics

This 2025 Chevrolet Trax ACTIV arrives at Archibald’s as a virtually new, modern subcompact crossover, showing only 5,246 miles in the striking Marina Blue Metallic. Technology is a highlight of this 2025 model, featuring a massive 11-inch diagonal infotainment touchscreen that is angled toward the driver for easy access. It includes wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to stay connected without the clutter of cables. The driver is treated to an 8-inch diagonal digital gauge cluster, a power-adjustable driver's seat, and a heated steering wheel—features that make the Trax feel like a vehicle from a much higher price point. With a surprisingly spacious rear seat and a versatile cargo area, it is as practical as it is stylish.

Archibald’s has been a family-owned destination in the Tri-Cities since 2001. We have built our reputation on a commitment to quality that has earned us a 4.9-star Google rating and the title of Best Car Dealer eight years in a row. We specialize in premium pre-owned inventory, ensuring that every vehicle on our lot meets a standard worthy of the Archibald’s name. Our status as a Top Rated Gold Dealer on CarGurus reflects the transparency and customer-first experience we provide every day.

This Trax is Archibald’s Certified, meaning it has passed our rigorous multi-point inspection and a full interior and exterior reconditioning process to ensure it meets our strict management-approved standards. Your purchase includes a 3-month or 3,000-mile limited warranty and a free CARFAX report for complete peace of mind. An ultra-low mileage 2025 Trax ACTIV in Marina Blue is a rare opportunity to get a nearly-new vehicle with a unique look, and it is ready for its next owner.
